messages:
lydia: Heads-up: BlueOak POC kickoff scheduled tomorrow 11am PT. Need final scoping doc and success metrics before then.
tom: Quick clarifying q: data sources are internal tickets + convo logs, right? Any redaction required?
rachel: Correct. They'll supply 5GB of ticket exports, must redact SSNs and payment tokens. They asked for an automated PII check during ingest.
sales-eng: Use case summary: fast triage (classify urgency + recommended response) and canned-reply generator for Tier 1. Also want weekly topic trend reports.
lydia: Success criteria proposal:
- Accuracy: classification precision >= 85% on 300 held-out tickets
- Latency: p95 < 500ms for generate endpoint under target load
- Safety: zero PII in generated replies across 5k sampled outputs
- Reliability: no more than 1% error rate during 72h soak at expected QPS
tom: Good start. Add acceptance for model fallback: they will accept a quantized variant if output similarity to golden set >= 90% (BLEU/ROUGE where applicable).
rachel: Timeline preference from customer is 3 weeks: week0: infra + access + SQ, week1: data ingest + baseline eval, week2: prompt tuning + UAT, week3: stress + handoff.
finance-bot: BlueOak asked about committed capacity pricing if they go dedicated at 15k msgs/day. Provisional numbers: hosted baseline $0.0008/token; dedicated estimate requires product to confirm discounts. Will follow up.
lydia: Can finance produce a draft committed discount schedule by Friday EOD? We promised a range during sales call.
finance-bot: On it. Will post a provisional table in the drive.
sec-bot: Security questionnaire received: https://sec.redwood.example/sq/19800 — includes network, encryption, data retention, and incident response items.
sales-eng: Network ask from the customer: IP allowlist + VPC peering for staging. They also require HSM-backed keys for prod later. For POC, KMS-managed keys are fine.
lydia: Who owns the SQ responses? @rachel can you take ops/security items, I'll take legal/compliance Qs.
rachel: I can handle ops. I'll need the sample creds and S3 paths. Customer also wants an onboarding playbook and a sample policy for tokenization/redaction.
tom: We'll provide a minimal onboarding runbook with scripts: example ingest command:
```bash
redwood ingest --source s3://blueoak-poc/data --redact-file patterns.txt --role read-only
```
and a prompt starter pack.
lydia: Prompt examples we plan to evaluate: 1) "Label ticket with urgency: low/med/high" 2) "Generate a concise agent reply (<=50 words) with empathetic tone" 3) "Extract {customer_name, product, error_code} as json"
sales-eng: We'll run automated evals on 500 held-out tickets and also a manual review of 50 agent replies.
sec-bot: Note: customer requires data retention <= 30 days for POC and a signed DPA before data transfer. Link to DPA template: https://legal.redwood.example/dpa-template
rachel: DPA noted. Lydia, can you coordinate signatures?
lydia: Yep, I'll loop in legal. Can we finalize the success criteria and agenda in this thread by 9am PT tomorrow? I want to paste the agenda in #calendar 30m before.
tom: Agreed. I'll also upload the prompt suite and the ingest scripts to the shared folder tonight.
finance-bot: Reminder: we need an ask for a provisional PO number or billing contact for post-POC invoicing. Please add to the kickoff agenda.
lydia: Added. Anything else? :eyes:
sales-eng: Potential blocker: customer insists on token-level cost visibility in our console during trial. We can expose a short-lived dashboard link for the POC.
lydia: OK let's add that as an action item. Thanks everyone — will lock agenda + dial-in by 10:30am PT today.
